therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: physical exercise-induced neuroplasticity and cognitive enhancement
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: brain function improvement through exercise-mediated neuroplasticity
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: early dementia and normative older adults

biomarker_changes: neurophysiological function measured via EEG and ERP
subgroup_findings: early dementia group showed improvements in Stroop test (137.67 to 116.51 seconds), Figure Copy (16.44 to 22.06 points), Figure Delayed Recall (3.28 to 7.81 points), and Fuld Immediate/Delayed Recall
normative older adults showed improvements in Digits Backward (5.50 to 6.83 points), Color Trails (124.00 to 96.11 seconds), and Figure Delayed Recall (14.50 to 18.25 points)

context.indication: cognitive decline, dementia, Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment
